payload.purpose_context: The events domain's Java services now live in spec-kitty-events (ADR 2026-10-29-1). Core needs one dependable way to consume a released service build: a pinned, checksummed reference, a verified download into a shared cache for developers, CI and users, and a launcher that fails closed with a named reason and remedy. The same mechanism serves the charter backend service (#6590) and the write-service launcher (#6676).
payload.purpose_tldr: Core pins, fetches, verifies and launches the backend service binaries released by spec-kitty-events (and later spec-kitty-charter), and refuses to run without a verified one.

options: Resolve, verify and refuse only; start, health and stale recovery follow with #6195
Full lifecycle now: start, reuse, health, stale recovery, tested against a fake service that speaks the 2026-10-27-1 protocol
payload.question: How much of the launcher lifecycle does this mission build, given that the write-service binary (command-cli) does not exist yet?

options: Yes, only behind an explicit opt-in (env var SPEC_KITTY_SERVICE_UNPINNED=1) that prints a warning on every start
No, every executed binary must match a pinned sha256; developers bump a local pin instead
payload.question: May a developer run a locally built service binary that matches no pin (for example while working in spec-kitty-events)?

payload.final_answer: Full lifecycle now: resolve, verify, start/reuse, health, stale recovery, fail-closed codes; tested against a fake service speaking the ADR 2026-10-27-1 protocol
Opt-in escape hatch: SPEC_KITTY_SERVICE_UNPINNED=1 plus an explicit binary path; warning on every start; never set by CLI tests or CI

payload.question: Launch/stop contract between core and service binaries, plus engineering alignment

payload.final_answer: Approved alignment: kernel stdlib pin/verify/cache/download owner + gate; specify_cli/services launcher + service CLI group, sync script/make/action; process contract accepted by spec-kitty-events operator 2026-10-29; fake service + file:// fixture release, no real pin
